newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NEDCOR ENTERS ALLIANCE WITH LEADING UK FUND.
newsitem.headline: NEDCOR ENTERS ALLIANCE WITH LEADING UK FUND.

text.p: Nedcor Bank Ltd said on Wednesday it had chosen UK fund managers Schroder Investment Management as its partner in offering offshore unit trusts.
The bank said Schroders, which is considered to be one of the world's top investment management firms managing over $150 billion worth of funds worldwide, would manage its range of off-shore funds.
"Schroders was Nedcor Bank's first choice as a partner to manage our off-shore unit trusts," Nedcor chief executive Richard Laubscher said in a statement.
He said the company's consistency in providing solid, superior investment performance made it an ideal partner and would ensure "excellent" results for clients.
Schroders, which operates in more than 20 countries, was known for its success in the Asia Pacific region, Laubscher added.
